## Question / 问题描述

Clearly and concisely describe your question or doubt.
清晰简明地描述您的问题或疑问。

## Background / 背景

Provide background information to help others understand your use case.
提供问题的背景信息，帮助他人理解您的使用场景。

## Environment / 环境信息

- ErisPulse Version / 版本: [e.g. 2.3.8]
- Python Version / Python 版本: [e.g. 3.11.0]
- Operating System / 操作系统: [e.g. Windows 11 / macOS / Linux]
- Adapter Used / 使用的适配器: [e.g. TelegramAdapter, OneBot11Adapter]

## Relevant Code / 相关代码

If the question involves code, provide a minimal reproducible example / 如果问题涉及代码，请提供最小可复现代码：

```python
# Paste your code here / 在这里粘贴代码
```

## Attempted Solutions / 已尝试的解决方案

Describe solutions you have already tried.
描述您已经尝试过的解决方案。

## Additional Information / 额外信息

Add any other information or screenshots.
添加任何其他信息或截图。

## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] I have searched existing issues and documentation and did not find an answer / 我已搜索现有的 issues 和文档，确认没有找到答案
- [ ] I have provided a clear question description and background / 我已提供清晰的问题描述和背景
- [ ] I have provided environment information / 我已提供环境信息
- [ ] I have provided relevant code or screenshots (if applicable) / 我已提供相关代码或截图（如适用）
